title: Memory of Trump's humiliating Helsinki train wreck looms over upcoming Putin meeting in Alaska - Main Stream Videos
text:
Jen Psaki points out that Russia President Vladimir Putin is already benefitting from the planned meeting between him and Donald Trump at a U.S. military base in Alaska, and Donald Trump is already behind, with a track record of capitulation and caving to Putin, and his 2018 meeting with Putin in Helsinki still a fresh memory for most Americans.
